items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: Well, I had a uncle, great uncle, my father's uncle. He had a band. His name was Gunsey Montgomery.

ctx.x: Right up on the, above Hammond, up that way. That's right. Can you remember the first music you ever heard? Were your parents, for instance, musicians?
Well, I had a uncle, great uncle, my father's uncle. He had a band. His name was Gunsey Montgomery. He had the big four band out of Norleene, Louisiana.
Yeah. And what did he play?
